summary.tldr: Requires the National Research Council to publish housing cost summaries, governance details and a public registry for material housing-related model code proposals.
what_it_does: Defines a material housing-related model code proposal as a proposed model code change that could materially affect residential construction costs, housing delivery timelines, approval timelines, compliance complexity or administrative burden.
Requires the National Research Council to publish a housing cost and impact summary, in both official languages and an accessible format, when such a proposal is first made public for review.

Requires each summary to explain the proposal, its practical effect, estimated costs and benefits, expected impacts, uncertainties, assumptions, and the names, roles and affiliations of the people who advanced it.

Requires the Council to publish the relevant governance bodies and committees for each proposal, including member names, positions, roles and affiliations, plus a contact for technical and process questions.

Requires the Council to keep an accessible public registry with proposal status, key milestones, edition-level impact estimates, and annual summaries of code work and recurring cost-estimation or transparency issues.
States that a failure to publish, maintain or update these materials does not invalidate any national model code or any related action by provinces, territories or local governments.
summary.background: The bill amends the National Research Council Act. It applies to the Council's role supporting Canada's national model code development system.
